content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD etauv_solver.F with two subroutines. Lines 1-11 blank, L12-55 BSD license header. SUBROUTINE ESTIMATE_HUV(ISTEP) (L64-254, header L57-58: calculate eta, ubar, vbar using 3rd-order LK [SSP Runge-Kutta] scheme; Shi 05/12/2011; comment L79 cites MUSCL-Hancock, Zhou et al., p.7): first computes cell-centered fluxes P_center=0.5*(P(I+1,J)+P(I,J)), Q_center, and depth-averaged velocities U_davg=P_center/Max(H,MinDepthFrc), V_davg (L93-100, for radiation stress); then solves the mass equation over Jbeg:Jend/Ibeg:Iend: R1 = -1/DXg*(F_right*n_right+F_left*n_left)-1/DYg*(F_top*n_top+F_bottom*n_bottom) from face fluxes F_left=P(I,J), F_right=P(I+1,J), F_bottom=Q(I,J), F_top=Q(I,J+1) (L105-108), adding WaveMaker_Mass(I,J) inside the wavemaker footprint |xmk-Xc_WK|<Width_WK, |ymk-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 for wavemaker types WK_IRR/TMA_1D/JON_1D/JON_2D/WK_NEW_IRR/WK_NEW_DATA2D (Salatin et al. 2021) (L110-140), WK_REG (L141-158), WK_TIME (L159-175), WK_DATA2D (L177-193), with xmk,ymk computed from (iista-1)/(jjsta-1) per ykchoi Jan/23/2018 (npx/npy forms commented out); otherwise plain divergence (L195-198; comment L195-196 notes a version 1.1 bug that DXg,DYg should be DXg(),Dy()); Wsurf(I,J)=R1(I,J) stored as surface vertical velocity O(mu^2) (fyshi 07/07/2022, L204-205); Eta(I,J)=ALPHA(ISTEP)*Eta0(I,J)+BETA(ISTEP)*(Eta(I,J)+DT*R1(I,J)) (L210) with optional ETA_LIMITER clipping to TroughLimit/CrestLimit (L212-216); momentum updates: R2 from Fx,Fy faces plus SourceX and Ubar=ALPHA(ISTEP)*Ubar0+BETA(ISTEP)*(Ubar+DT*R2) (L224-232); R3 from Gx,Gy plus SourceY and Vbar (L239-247); then CALL GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV (L251). SUBROUTINE GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV (L268-438, header L258-266: Shi 09/17/2010, nesting bc 10/14/2012, ykchoi U0/V0 shift 08/06/2015, serial/parallel consistency + periodic bc in y 01/27/2016): H=Eta*Gamma3+Depth (L276); U0/V0 shift moved out to before 'Do istage=1,3' (comments L284-286); if DISPERSION, recovers U from Ubar by solving a tridiagonal system in x: coefficients tmp1,tmp2,tmp3 from Gamma1*MASK9*(b1,b2 depth terms)/DX^2 and RHS tmp4=Ubar*MASK/Max(H,MinDepthFrc)+Gamma1*MASK9*(-b1/2*dep^2*Vxy-b2*dep*DVxy) (L296-300), with LEFT_BC_IRR wavemaker correction tmp4=tmp4-tmp1*U(I-1,J) at I=Ibeg when n_west==MPI_PROC_NULL (L307-316), normalized myA=tmp1/tmp2 etc. when tmp2/=0 or MASK>0 else zero (L318-326), solved by TRIDx (L330) with U=myF (L331); in y direction the analogous system (L334-378) has a DISP_TIME_LEFT variant whose coefficients include Gamma2 nonlinear free-surface terms with reta,retal,retar (L343-358) versus the plain Gamma1 form (L360-364), solved by TRIDy_periodic (Sherman-Morrison, 01/27/2016 fyshi, L382-385) when PERIODIC else TRIDy (L387-388); if no DISPERSION, U=Ubar/Max(H,MinDepthFrc), V likewise (L392-399). Final loop (L402-427): where MASK<1 zero Ubar,Vbar,U,V,HU,HV; else HU=Max(H,MinDepthFrc)*U, HV likewise, and apply Froude cap: if Utotal/Fr>FroudeCap with Utotal=sqrt(U^2+V^2), Fr=sqrt(GRAV*Max(H,MinDepthFrc)), rescale U,V to FroudeCap*Fr preserving direction Utheta=ATAN2(V,U) and recompute HU,HV (L414-423). If .NOT.DISPERSION, Ubar=HU, Vbar=HV (ykchoi 07/26/2016, L429-436).

unresolved: WK_Source computation is fully commented out (L125-130,L136) — wavemaker mass source now comes from WaveMaker_Mass computed in sources.F per comment L123
locals kf,kd (L77) and IM (L273) are declared but unused in this file (kf appears only in the commented-out WK_Source block L126-130)

tmp1..tmp4, I, J, and all state arrays (P,Q,Fx,Fy,Gx,Gy,SourceX,SourceY,Eta,Eta0,Ubar,Vbar,ALPHA,BETA,DXg,DYg,b1,b2,Gamma1,Gamma2,Gamma3,MASK,MASK9,Wsurf,WaveMaker_Mass,CrestLimit,TroughLimit,FroudeCap,iista,jjsta,n_west,MPI_PROC_NULL etc.) come from USE GLOBAL — cross-file definitions

ALPHA(ISTEP)/BETA(ISTEP) RK stage coefficients (L210,L232,L247) are defined elsewhere; the '3rd-order LK scheme' of header L58 vs 'MUSCL-Hancock, Zhou et al., p. 7' of L79 refer to external references not resolvable in-file
condition IF(tmp2.NE.0.0_SP.OR.MASK(I,J).GT.0) (L318,L368) mixes an OR where an AND might be expected (a dry cell with tmp2/=0 still divides by tmp2); intent not stated in file
TRIDx/TRIDy/TRIDy_periodic (L330,L384,L387) are defined in another file

the four wavemaker branches WK_IRR-group/WK_REG/WK_TIME/WK_DATA2D (L110-193) compute identical R1 expressions differing only by which wavemaker string matches; LEFT_BC_IRR affects only the tridiagonal RHS (L309-314), not R1
